detonationDamage.description: The damage of the detonation, from the `damage` of `explosionParams`.

ArmorStats.description: The suit armour of an item, raw facts of `SCItemSuitArmorParams` (ADR-0072).

damageResistance.description:
The `damageResistance` of the `DamageResistanceMacro` Record that `damageResistance` links
to; `null` without a readable one.

Blueprint.description: A crafting blueprint: a `CraftingBlueprintRecord` Record under `crafting/blueprints/crafting`.

categoryGuid.description:
The GUID of the category Record, the `guid` of a `blueprintCategories` entry; `null`
without a category or when its Record is a left-out leftover or unreadable.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `BP_CRAFT_behr_lmg_ballistic_01_mag`.

craftTimeSeconds.description: The craft time of the first tier in seconds, `null` without one.

defaultAvailable.description:
Whether the blueprint is one the player has by default
(`CraftingGlobalParams.defaultBlueprintSelection`).

dismantle.description:
What dismantling the produced item returns, `null` without a produced item, for an item
that cannot be dismantled, and unless the Build holds exactly one dismantle process.

ingredients.description:
The ingredients of the first tier in stored order, derived from `tiers`: a selection is
flattened depth first, so its count, quantity multipliers and quality modifiers are not
represented here.

key.description: The blueprint key, the Record name.

producedItemGuid.description:
The GUID of the entity the blueprint produces, `null` without one or for a Reference to
a Record the DataForge lacks.

tiers.description:
Every tier in stored order with its craft time and its costs, selections kept as
`select` lines. The first one is the tier `craftTimeSeconds` and `ingredients` describe.

BlueprintCategory.description:
A blueprint category: a `BlueprintCategoryRecord` Record under `crafting/blueprintcategories`,
the target of the `categoryGuid` of a blueprint.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `FPSArmours`.

name.description: The name; the Record holds no field for one, so the key is `null`.

BlueprintDismantle.description:
What dismantling the item of a blueprint returns: a link to the process and the tier.

The item returns the share `efficiency` of the process of the costs of the tier `tierIndex`,
except the resources in `craftingGlobal.dismantleExcludedResourceGuids`. A `select` is not
resolved and the quantity multiplier is not applied; these are assumptions, not verified
against the game.

tierIndex.description:
The index into `tiers` of the tier whose costs are returned, `null` for a blueprint
without a tier.

BlueprintPool.description:
A blueprint pool: a `BlueprintPoolRecord` under `crafting/blueprintrewards` that a reward
draws a blueprint from.

A source gives the blueprint of an entry with the chance of the source times the weight of the
entry over `totalWeight`.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

rewardSources.description: The places that reward a blueprint of the pool, found through their Reference to it.

totalWeight.description: The sum of the positive weights of the entries.

BlueprintTier.description: One tier of a blueprint: its craft time and its costs.

craftTimeSeconds.description: The craft time of the tier in whole seconds, `null` without one.

mandatory.description: The mandatory cost, usually a `select`; `null` without one.

optional.description: The optional costs in stored order.

changeNumber.description: The Perforce change number the Build was made from.

publicPatch.description:
The public patch version, e.g. `4.7.2`, from the RSI Launcher log line with the same
change number; `null` when the log has none.

ClothingStats.description: The worn properties of an item, raw facts of `SCItemClothingParams`.

Commodity.description:
A commodity: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/commodities` or a
`ResourceType` Record a blueprint ingredient uses that no commodity Record carries.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Gold`.

densityGramsPerCubicCentimetre.description:
The density of the `ResourceType` in grams per cubic centimetre (game field
`gramsPerCubicCentimeter`), `null` without a `ResourceType`, a density or a density in
another unit.

description.description:
The description, from the entity's display parameters or, without one, from the
`ResourceType` Record of the commodity.

displayType.description:
The display type of the purchasable parameters, e.g. `@items_commodities_type_metal`;
without a key for a `ResourceType` entry.

guid.description: The GUID of the Record; for a `ResourceType` entry the GUID of the `ResourceType`.

refinedSubtypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record `refinedVersion` of the `ResourceType` links to; `null`
without a `ResourceType` or a `refinedVersion`. It equals the `subtypeGuid` of the refined
commodity only when the catalog has that commodity.

subtypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record the commodity's default composition holds first,
`null` without one. The `resourceGuid` of an ingredient equals the
`subtypeGuid` of exactly one commodity.

typeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceTypeGroup` Record that directly lists the `ResourceType`, the
`guid` of a `resourceGroups` entry; `null` without a `ResourceType` or a group.

ContractEntry.description:
A contract or one of its sub contracts, with the overrides of sub contract, contract and
handler laid over the template.

contractor.description:
The `Contractor` string parameter of the first level that states one (sub contract,
contract, handler): the text the game shows as the giver of the contract, e.g. the
agency, when the contract has no faction reputation.

debugName.description: The `debugName` of the contract, `null` when it has none.

faction.description:
The `factionReputation` of the handler, as stored: the faction of a contract that has no
reputation result, e.g. the collector's. `null` when the handler names none.

handler.description: The `debugName` of the handler that holds the contract, `null` when it has none.

missionType.description: The localised name of the mission type.

missionTypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `MissionType` Record: the override of the sub contract, else of the
contract, else of the handler, else the type of the template, else the type of the
contract's `MissionBrokerEntry`; `null` when there is none.

notForRelease.description: Whether the contract is marked `notForRelease`, `null` when the flag is absent.

pickupPlaces.description:
Where the contract is offered or picked up, at most five starmap objects: those of the
`MissionLocality` and location prerequisites of the sub contract (else of the contract and
its handler), a star left out, the star system first, then planets and moons, then the
rest, each group in stored order. When none of those is left (nothing named, or only stars
or objects missing from `starmapObjects`), the `locationMissionAvailable` of the contract's
`MissionBrokerEntry`. Empty when that names none either or the starmap objects are not part
of the catalog build.

recordGuid.description: The GUID of the `ContractGenerator` Record that holds the contract.

recordPath.description: The record path of the `ContractGenerator` Record, without `.xml`.

reputationGains.description:
The reputation the contract grants on success, one entry per amount: the results whose
first mission result (success) is set. A result that fires on failure only is left out; an
amount may be negative (a success that costs standing with a rival, as stored).

subContractGuid.description:
The `id` of the sub contract; `null` for the contract itself. A contract with sub
contracts has its own entry and one entry per sub contract.

templateGuid.description: The GUID of the `ContractTemplate` Record the contract names, `null` when it names none.

title.description:
The title: the `Title` of the sub contract, else of the contract, else of the handler, else
the first display string of the template, else the title of the contract's
`MissionBrokerEntry`. A `~mission(Token)` in it is replaced by the text the first of sub
contract, contract, handler and template states for the token, or by a placeholder such as
`[LOCATION]`, `[TARGET]` or `[SHIP]` for what the game picks when the mission starts, or
`[TOKEN]` when nothing states it. Trailing and leading blanks are removed.

workInProgress.description: Whether the contract is marked `workInProgress`, `null` when the flag is absent.

ContractFaction.description: The faction a handler names for its contracts.

displayName.description: The `displayName` of the faction reputation, e.g. `Wikelo Emporium`.

guid.description: The GUID of the faction reputation Record.

name.description: The Record name of the faction reputation, e.g. `factionreputation_wikelo`.

coolingRate.description:
The `amount` of the first `generation` flow of `resourceStates` whose resource is
`Coolant`.

CostLine.description:
One cost of a tier: a selection ("choose n") of costs, a resource line or an item line.

The fields of the other lines are `null`, or empty for `options` and `modifiers`.

compositionInclusion.description:
The option of `CraftingCostContext_ResultCompositionInclusion`, e.g. `Include`; `null`
without one. A closed set the game may extend.

count.description:
A `select`: how many options the player chooses, `null` when the Record holds no count.
Fewer than `options` offers means the player may leave options out.

itemGuid.description: An `item`: the GUID of the entity.

kind.description:
What the line is: `select`, `resource` or `item`. A closed set; a reader maps an unknown
value to nothing.

minQuality.description: A `resource` or `item`: the minimum quality, `null` without one.

modifiers.description:
The gameplay properties the line's quality scales
(`CraftingCostContext_ResultGameplayPropertyModifiers`).

options.description: A `select`: the options in stored order.

quantityMultiplier.description: The `CraftingCostContext_QuantityMultiplier` factor of the line, `null` without one.

quantityScu.description: A `resource`: the quantity in standard cargo units (SCU), before the quantity multiplier.

quantityUnits.description: An `item`: the number of units, before the quantity multiplier.

resourceGuid.description: A `resource`: the GUID of the `ResourceType` Record.

slot.description: A `select`: the debug name of the slot, `null` without one.

slotKey.description: A `select`: the localisation key of the slot name, `null` without one or for a placeholder.

CraftingGlobal.description: The `CraftingGlobalParams` Records, merged: what applies to every dismantle.

dismantleExcludedItemGuids.description: The entities that cannot be dismantled; their blueprints have no `dismantle`.

Damage.description: Damage by type, as the Archive states it.

DamageResistance.description: The resistances of a `DamageResistanceMacro`, one entry per damage type.

DismantleProcess.description:
A generic dismantle process: a `CraftingBlueprintRecord` under `crafting/blueprints/dismantle`
whose process is a `GenericCraftingProcess_Dismantle`.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

efficiency.description:
The share of the costs a dismantled item returns, 0 to 1, `null` when the Record holds
none.

timeSeconds.description: The dismantle time in whole seconds, `null` when the Record holds none.

FireAction.description: One fire mode of a weapon.

damagePerSecond.description: `damagePerSecond`, the damage a beam does each second; `null` for a mode without one.

fireRate.description:
`fireRate`, in rounds per minute. `fireRate`, `heatPerShot`, `chargeTime`,
`overchargeTime`, `cooldownTime`, `name` and `launchParams` are read from the fire mode and,
where it has none of its own, from its `weaponAction`.

kind.description:
The struct of the fire mode, e.g. `SWeaponActionFireRapidParams`. A closed set the game
may extend; the schema keeps a string.

pellets.description:
`launchParams.pelletCount` (`pellets` where a Record states that instead), the projectiles of
one shot.

GameplayProperty.description:
A gameplay property definition: a `CraftingGameplayPropertyDef` Record under
`crafting/craftedproperties`, the target of the `propertyGuid` of a modifier.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

name.description: The name of the property; a placeholder key leaves `en` and `de` `null`.

Guid.description: A GUID as canonical lower-case UUID text.

Ingredient.description: One ingredient line of a blueprint: a resource or an item with its quantity.

itemGuid.description: The GUID of the entity of an item line, `null` for a resource line.

minQuality.description: The minimum quality the ingredient must have, `null` without one.

quantityScu.description: The quantity of a resource line in standard cargo units (SCU), `null` for an item line.

quantityUnits.description: The quantity of an item line in units, `null` for a resource line.

resourceGuid.description: The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record of a resource line, `null` for an item line.

slot.description: The debug name of the slot the ingredient fills, `null` without one.

slotKey.description: The localisation key of the slot name, `null` without one or for a placeholder.

Item.description: An item: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/scitem` or `entities/legacyitems`.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `POWR_ACAS_S01_Lumen`.

displayType.description: The display type of the purchasable parameters, e.g. `@item_DisplayType_PowerPlant`.

itemClass.description:
The item class from the `Class:` line of the English description, `null` for another
value or without that line. Today one of `Civilian`, `Competition`, `Industrial`,
`Military` and `Stealth`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

manufacturerGuid.description:
The GUID of the manufacturer the Reference `AttachDef.Manufacturer` links to, `null` for
a null Reference.

mass.description: The mass in kilograms of the physics controller, `null` without one.

playability.description:
Who the item is for, `null` when no rule applies. Today one of `player`, `mission` and
`special`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

stats.description:
The typed stat blocks of a weapon, shield, quantum drive, power plant, cooler or missile,
raw facts without derived values (ADR-0065); `null` for any other item.

subType.description: The item subtype of `AttachDef.SubType`, e.g. `Power`, `null` without one.

tags.description: The words of `AttachDef.Tags`, in stored order.

type.description: The item type of `AttachDef.Type`, e.g. `PowerPlant`, `null` without one.

variantOf.description:
The GUID of the base of the variant group the item belongs to, `null` for a base and for an
item that is alone in its group. It is the `guid` of an entry of `items`.

ItemStats.description:
The typed stat blocks of an item, raw facts of the Archive (ADR-0065, ADR-0072).

Every block is `null` for an item that does not have it; the item has `stats` only when it
has at least one block: `weapon`, `shield`, `quantumDrive`, `powerPlant`, `cooler`, `missile`,
`armor`, `clothing`, `radar`, `tractorBeam` or `weaponModifier`. No value is derived: a number
is what the Archive states, in the unit the game stores it; a value that is not a finite
number is `null`.

cooler.description: The cooler block, for an item of the type `Cooler`.

powerPlant.description: The power plant block, for an item of the type `PowerPlant`.

resourceStates.description: The states of `ItemResourceComponentParams` in stored order: signatures and resource flows.

tractorBeam.description: The tractor beam block, from the `SWeaponActionFireTractorBeamParams` of the weapon.

weaponModifier.description:
The tractor and salvage multipliers of an attachment, from
`EntityComponentAttachableModifierParams`.

KindCompleteness.description: Whether a kind holds every Record of the Build or only those a Filter selected.

oneOf.description: Every Record of the kind is listed; one missing from the catalog was removed from the game.
Only the Records the Filter selected are listed.

Loadout.description: The ports of a ship or of an item that has ports, and what the Default Loadout puts into them.

entityGuid.description:
The `guid` of the entry in `ships` or `items` the ports belong to; loadouts are ordered by
it.

entityKind.description:
Which kind `entityGuid` is an entry of, `ship` or `item`; a closed set the game may
extend, so the schema keeps a string.

issues.description:
The codes of the problems that kept part of the Loadout from being read, e.g.
`xml_loadout`, sorted and without duplicates; empty when everything was read.

ports.description:
The ports of the Entity: those a Loadout names in Loadout order, then the other defined
ports in definition order, then the item ports of the vehicle implementation no Record
port names.

LoadoutPort.description: One item port and what the Default Loadout attaches to it.

displayNameKey.description: The localisation key of the port's display name; `null` for none or a placeholder key.

dockedVehicle.description:
Whether the attached Entity is a docked vehicle, e.g. a snub craft in a hangar port. Its
ports are not listed.

flags.description:
The flags of the port as stored, split at white space, without a leading `$`, e.g.
`invisible`, `uneditable`.

itemClassName.description:
The class name of the attached Entity, or the class name the Loadout names; `null` for an
empty port or an unresolved Reference.

itemGuid.description:
The `guid` of the entry in `items` (or, for a docked vehicle, in `ships`) the port holds
by default; `null` for an empty port. For an attachment that cannot be resolved it is the
GUID the Loadout names, which may belong to no entry, or `null` when the Loadout names a
class name only.

maxSize.description: The largest item size the port takes, `null` when the data gives none.

minSize.description: The smallest item size the port takes, `null` when the data gives none.

name.description: The port name, as the Loadout or the port definition spells it.

portTags.description:
The tags the port offers: the words of the stored value, split at white space and
otherwise unchanged, like `tags` of an item.

ports.description:
The ports of the attached Entity under this Loadout, or the ports of the nested Loadout of
an empty port; empty for a port without either.

requiredTags.description:
The tags an item must carry to fit the port: the words of the stored value, split at white
space and otherwise unchanged, like `tags` of an item.

source.description:
Where the attachment comes from: `loadout` (the Entity's own Default Loadout), `override`
(the Loadout of the entry that attached the Entity), `port_default` (the default item of
the port definition), `unset` (the port is defined and holds nothing) or `vehicle` (the
port is known only from the vehicle implementation and holds nothing). A closed set the
game may extend, so the schema keeps a string.

types.description: The item types the port takes, in stored order; empty when the data names none.

unresolved.description:
The code of the error that kept the attachment from being resolved, e.g.
`dangling_reference` or `unknown_class`; `null` otherwise.

visibility.description:
Whether the vehicle implementation shows the port: `visible`, `invisible` or
`unspecified` when it names no part of that name. A closed set the game may extend, so the
schema keeps a string.

LocalisedText.description:
A text the game localises: its localisation key and the resolved English and German texts,
as the language's `global.ini` stores them with the escape `\n` decoded to a line feed.

de.description:
The German text, `null` for no key, a placeholder key, or a key the German `global.ini`
lacks or holds empty.

en.description:
The English text, `null` for no key, a placeholder key, or a key the English `global.ini`
lacks or holds empty.

key.description: The localisation key, e.g. `@manufacturer_NameACAS`, `null` when it is unknown.

LocationOverride.description: A distribution that replaces the default one at a location.

distribution.description: The distribution at the location, `null` when the Record holds none.

locationGuid.description: The GUID of the location Record, `null` for a null Reference.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `ACAS` for `SCItemManufacturer.ACAS`.

code.description: The manufacturer code, e.g. `ACAS`, `null` when it cannot be read.

MineableElement.description:
A mineable element: a `MineableElement` Record under `mining/mineableelements`. Several
elements may link to the same `ResourceType`, so none is picked for a commodity.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `agricium_ore`.

instability.description: `elementInstability`, from 0 to 1000 on LIVE; `null` when the Record states none.

resourceTypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record the Reference `resourceType` links to. It equals a
commodity's `subtypeGuid` only when the catalog has that commodity (20 of the 41 linked
`ResourceType`s on LIVE). `null` for a null or dangling Reference.

damage.description: The damage of the explosion, from the `damage` of `explosionParams`.

trackingSignalType.description:
`targetingParams.trackingSignalType`. A closed set the game may extend; the schema keeps a
string.

Paint.description: A paint: an item of the type `Paints` and the ships it fits.

itemGuid.description: The `guid` of the paint's entry in `items`, which holds its name and record.

shipGuids.description:
The GUIDs of the ships the paint fits, ordered by GUID; empty when it fits none. Each
is the `guid` of an entry of `ships`.

PickupPlace.description: A place a contract is picked up at: an object of the starmap.

objectType.description: The type of the starmap object, e.g. `Planet`.

place.description: The name of the place, as the starmap object states it.

PoolEntry.description: One entry of a blueprint pool.

blueprintGuid.description: The GUID of the blueprint, `null` for a null Reference.

weight.description: The weight of the entry among the pool's, `null` when the Record holds none.

PortType.description: An item type a port takes.

subTypes.description:
The item subtypes the port takes; empty when it takes every subtype or the data gives
none.

powerOutput.description: The `amount` of the first `generation` flow of `resourceStates` whose resource is `Power`.

PropertyModifier.description: A gameplay property of the crafted item with the ranges that scale it by quality.

propertyGuid.description: The GUID of the `gameplayProperties` entry, `null` for a null Reference.

kind.description:
The struct of the distribution, e.g. `CraftingQualityDistributionNormal`. A closed set the
game may extend.

QualityDistribution.description:
A quality distribution Record under `crafting/qualitydistribution`: the default distribution
of a source or the list of its location overrides.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

distribution.description: The distribution of a `CraftingQualityDistributionRecord`, `null` for an override Record.

overrides.description: The overrides of a `CraftingQualityLocationOverrideRecord`, empty for a default Record.

RefiningProcess.description:
A refining process: a `RefiningProcess` Record under `refiningprocess`, one method of a
refinery. The DataForge holds no yields.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `processingtype-fastcareful`.

processName.description:
The name of the method, from `processName`. The localisation key and the texts are game
texts.

refiningQuality.description:
`refiningQuality`, one of `Wasteful`, `Normal` and `Careful` on LIVE; `null` when the Record
states none. The schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

refiningSpeed.description:
`refiningSpeed`, one of `Slow`, `Normal` and `Fast` on LIVE; `null` when the Record states
none. The schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

ReputationGain.description: One reputation amount a contract grants on success.

amount.description: The `reputationAmount` of the reward Record, `null` when it cannot be read.

factionReputationGuid.description: The GUID of the faction reputation Record, `null` when the result names none.

factionReputationName.description: The Record name of the faction reputation, `null` when the result names none.

scopeGuid.description: The GUID of the reputation scope Record, `null` when the result names none.

scopeName.description:
The Record name of the reputation scope, e.g. the faction or the affinity scope, `null`
when the result names none.

ResistanceEntry.description:
The resistance to one damage type, as stored: the multiplier is the factor damage is scaled
by, not a mitigation.

ResourceFlow.description: One generation or consumption of a resource, per second, in the unit the Archive states.

amount.description: The first number of `resourceAmountPerSecond`, in the unit named by `unit`.

direction.description: `generation` or `consumption`: the field of the delta that holds the flow.

kind.description:
The struct of the delta, e.g. `ItemResourceDeltaGeneration`. A closed set the game may
extend; the schema keeps a string.

resource.description: The `resource`, e.g. `Power`. A closed set the game may extend; the schema keeps a string.

unit.description:
The struct that holds the amount, e.g. `SPowerSegmentResourceUnit`; the units of two
structs differ and are not converted.

ResourceGroup.description:
A resource group: a `ResourceTypeGroup` Record under `resourcetypedatabase`, the type the
`typeGuid` of a commodity points at.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Metal`.

name.description: The name, from `displayName`; a placeholder key leaves `en` and `de` `null`.

parentGuid.description:
The GUID of the group that lists this group in its `groups`, the `guid` of another
`resourceGroups` entry; `null` for a top-level group. It is the direct parent: the groups
form a forest of unfixed depth, so follow it with a guard against cycles.

ResourceState.description: One state of the resource component: its signatures and the resources it generates and uses.

flows.description: The `generation` and `consumption` of the state's `deltas`, in stored order.

RewardSource.description:
A place that rewards a blueprint of a pool with a chance: a `BlueprintRewards` result of a
contract.

chance.description:
The chance that the reward is given as the Record states it, 0 to 1 on LIVE and not
clamped, `null` when the Record holds none.

contractId.description: The `id` of the nearest enclosing struct that has one, e.g. the contract.

recordGuid.description: The GUID of the Record that holds the reward.

recordPath.description: The record path of that Record, without `.xml`.

Ship.description:
A ship or ground vehicle: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/spaceships` or
`entities/groundvehicles`.

cargoGridsWithIssue.description:
How many cargo grids of the default Loadout have no readable capacity, e.g. because their
container Record does not exist.

cargoScu.description:
The cargo capacity in standard cargo units (SCU) of the cargo grids the default Loadout
reaches, rounded to four decimals: 0 for a ship without a cargo grid, `null` when it has
grids and none can be read. With `cargoGridsWithIssue` above 0 the value is a lower bound.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `AEGS_Avenger_Titan`.

description.description: The description, from `vehicleDescription` of the vehicle parameters.

hullHealth.description:
The hull hit points: the sum of the positive `damageMax` of the structural parts of the
vehicle implementation, rounded to four decimals. `null` without a vehicle implementation
or when no part states a `damageMax`.

manufacturerGuid.description:
The GUID of the manufacturer the Reference `manufacturer` links to, `null` for a null
Reference.

mass.description:
The hull mass in kilograms, without the Loadout, the docked vehicles and the landing gear:
the sum of the `mass` of the parts of the vehicle implementation after the Modification
the ship selects, rounded to four decimals. `null` when neither the parts nor the physics
controller state one, never 0.

massBasis.description:
What `mass` is the sum of. Today one of `parts` and `physics`; the schema keeps a string,
as a new value is additive. `null` exactly when `mass` is.

name.description: The name, from `vehicleName` of the vehicle parameters.

playability.description:
Who the ship is for, `null` when no rule applies. Today one of `player`, `ai`, `mission`
and `special`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

size.description: The item size of `AttachDef.Size`, `null` without one.

variantOf.description:
The GUID of the base of the variant group the ship belongs to: the ships that share the
vehicle definition and the vehicle implementation after the Modification. `null` for a base
and for a ship that is alone in its group. It is the `guid` of an entry of `ships`.

vehicleDefinition.description: The path of the vehicle definition XML, `null` without one.

vehicleKind.description:
Spaceship or ground vehicle, `null` when the record path and the vehicle implementation
do not settle it. Today one of `spaceship` and `groundVehicle`; the schema keeps a string,
as a new value is additive.

ShipStoreSlug.description: An RSI store slug and the ship it stands for.

className.description: The `className` of the ship the slug maps to, `null` for a retired slug.

retired.description:
Whether the slug's ship no longer exists in the game data; the slug stays so that a
pledge of it is recognised as retired.

rsiId.description: The ship id of the RSI store.

shipGuid.description: The `guid` of the ship of `ships` the slug maps to, `null` for a retired slug.

slug.description:
The slug of the ship in the RSI store, the last segment of its pledge URL, e.g.
`Aurora-Mk-I-ES`; entries are ordered by it.

storeName.description: The ship name as the RSI store shows it.

Shop.description:
A shop: one `ShopBackup` entry of the shop registry `Data\Libs\CosmoTools\LayerRecovery\
LayerBackups.xml`, one placement of an `SCShop` Entity in the world. No prices and no stock; the
item GUIDs come only from an inventory file that the shop containers name (ADR-0071).

body.description:
The second container, the body or jump point the shop is below (e.g.
`OOC_Stanton_4_Microtech`, `pyro5`); `null` when the chain has none.

commodityExchange.description:
Whether the shop is a commodity exchange or commodity terminal: `entityName` starts with
`SCShop_CommEx_TDD_`, or starts with `SCShop_Platinumbay` and ends with `_Commodity`.

containers.description:
The names of the containers from the system root down to the one that holds the shop,
from the `SuperName` chain without its GUIDs and without the `SCShop` Entity.

defaultValue.description:
The `DefaultValue` GUID of the registry entry; `null` when it is empty. Shops with the same
`registryName` share it.

entityGuid.description:
The `CryGUID` of the `SCShop` Entity, the last element of `key`. A shop module placed in
several places keeps it, so it is no identity; it is the `CryGUID` the container's
`entitycomponentshop.xml` names.

entityName.description:
The name of the `SCShop` Entity, the last element of the registry's `SuperName`, e.g.
`SCShop_CommEx_TDD_NewBabbage`. An internal name, not a localisation key.

inventory.description:
The lower-case file stem of `Data\Scripts\ShopInventories\<stem>.json` that the `.soc` of
every shop container naming `entityGuid` gives the `SCShop` component (ADR-0071); `null`
when no container names a file, the containers disagree or the file is missing or
unreadable.

itemGuids.description:
The `EntityClassDefinition` GUIDs of the items in that inventory file, lower case, ordered
and without repeats; `null` exactly when `inventory` is. No price, stock or rental data.

key.description:
The identity: the `ID` chain of the registry entry, the `CryGUID`s of the containers from
the system root down to the `SCShop` Entity, comma separated. Unique in the catalog.

kind.description:
The kind from the path of the shop container whose `SCShop` Entity is `entityGuid`:
the folder below `PU\Shops` (e.g. `commex`, `clothing`), or `shopcomm` or `shopfood` for a
container below `PU\loc`. A closed set the game may extend; `null` when no container or
containers of different kinds hold the Entity.

location.description:
The third container, the location (e.g. `Area18_City_objectContainer`); `null` when the
chain has none.

registryName.description:
The `ShopName` of the registry entry, e.g. `Pharmacy_RestStop_ARC-LEO1`; `null` when it is
empty. An internal name, not a localisation key. Many shops share one.

starmapObjectGuid.description:
The `guid` of the `starmapObjects` entry whose `entityName` or `className` equals
`location` ignoring ASCII case; `null` when none does or more than one object does.

system.description:
The star system whose registry holds the shop: the platform name without the suffix
`system`, e.g. `stanton`, `pyro`.

archiveModified.description: The modification time of the Archive file, UTC in RFC 3339 form, `null` when unknown.

archiveSize.description: The size of the Archive file in bytes.

build.description: The Build from the Channel's build manifest, `null` when it is unknown.

channel.description: The Channel: the name of the folder holding the Archive, `null` when there is none.

exportedAt.description: When the catalog was written, UTC in RFC 3339 form.

toolVersion.description: The version of P4KX that wrote the catalog.

Spread.description: The spread of a fire mode, as stored in `SSpreadParams`.

StarmapObject.description:
A starmap object: a `StarMapObject` Record under `starmap/pu`, a star system, planet, moon,
station, jump point or other place, with its world position when a system container places it.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Stanton1_Hurston`.

entityName.description:
The `entityName` of the Child element that places the object, e.g. `jumppoint_stanton_pyro`;
`null` when it is not placed or the Child names none.

hideInStarmap.description:
Whether the starmap hides the object, from `hideInStarmap`; `null` when the Record states
none.

name.description:
The name of the place, from `name` of the Record. The localisation key and the texts are
game texts.

parentGuid.description:
The GUID of the object the Reference `parent` links to, `null` for a null Reference. Each
is the `guid` of an entry of `starmapObjects` unless its Record is missing or left out.

placedUnderGuid.description:
The GUID of the nearest object above this one in the container hierarchy, `null` when it
is not placed or hangs directly below the system. Each is a `guid` of `starmapObjects`
unless its Record is missing or left out.

system.description:
The star system that places the object: the folder below `ObjectContainers/PU/system`,
e.g. `stanton`; `null` when no system container places it.

type.description:
The type of the object: the `name` of the `StarMapObjectType` Record the Reference `type`
links to when that is a plain string, else the Record name without its type; `null` for a
null or dangling Reference. The schema keeps a string, as a new type is additive.

typeGuid.description: The GUID the Reference `type` links to, `null` for a null Reference.

ValueRange.description: One linear range of a modifier: the value at the quality `startQuality` and at `endQuality`.

atEnd.description: The modifier at the end quality, `null` when the Record holds none.

atStart.description: The modifier at the start quality, `null` when the Record holds none.

endQuality.description: The quality the range ends at, `null` when the Record holds none.

kind.description:
`multiplier` when the values are factors, `additive` when they are summands. A closed set;
a reader maps an unknown value to nothing.

startQuality.description: The quality the range starts at, `null` when the Record holds none.

WeaponModifierStats.description:
The tractor and salvage multipliers an attachment applies, from the `weaponStats` of its
`EntityComponentAttachableModifierParams`.

WeaponStats.description: A weapon: its fire modes and the ammunition it fires.

ammo.description:
The ammunition, from the `AmmoParams` Record that `ammoParamsRecord` of that container
links to; `null` without a readable one.

ammoCapacity.description:
`maxAmmoCount` of the ammo container: the weapon's own `SAmmoContainerComponentParams` or,
for a weapon without one, that of the magazine entity `ammoContainerRecord` links to. The
capacity of the magazine, not of the weapon body.

fireActions.description: The fire modes of `fireActions` in stored order; a sequence is flattened to its entries.

description: The Basetool catalog: the game data the basetool's P4K import reads.

blueprintCategories.description: The blueprint categories, ordered by GUID.

blueprintPools.description: The blueprint pools with the places that reward them, ordered by GUID.

completeness.description: Whether each kind is a complete snapshot of the Build.

contracts.description:
The contracts and sub contracts with resolved titles, mission types and the reputation they
grant on success, ordered by the GUID of the contract and then of the sub contract.

craftingGlobal.description: The global crafting parameters that apply to every dismantle.

dismantleProcesses.description: The dismantle processes, ordered by GUID.

gameplayProperties.description: The gameplay property definitions the quality modifiers refer to, ordered by GUID.

loadouts.description:
The ports of every ship and of every item that has ports, with what the Default Loadout
attaches to each, ordered by the GUID of the entity.

mineableElements.description: The mineable elements, ordered by GUID. Several may link to one `ResourceType`.

paints.description: The paints with the ships they fit, ordered by the GUID of the item.

qualityDistributions.description: The quality distributions and their location overrides, ordered by GUID.

refiningProcesses.description: The refining processes, ordered by GUID.

resourceGroups.description: The resource groups, ordered by GUID.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the catalog shape; an import rejects a version it does not know.

shipStoreSlugs.description:
The RSI store slugs that map to a ship of `ships`, with the retired ones flagged, ordered
by `slug`. A curated list, not read from the Archive.

shops.description: The shops of the shop registry with kind, brand and place, ordered by `key`.

source.description: The Archive and Build the catalog was made from.

starmapObjects.description: The starmap objects with their world positions, ordered by GUID.

title: P4KX Basetool catalog
